items.title: run-recovery.mjs: record accurate agentCallCount (incremented inside agentRun() and reviewArtifact()) and tokensSpent (accumulated from the claude -p JSON usage); keep wallClockMs
items.context: Pre-reg section 7 field names: tokensSpent, wallClockMs, agentCallCount. Fixes the reviewRounds undercount of reviewer calls

happy.desc: agentRun call increments agentCallCount by 1 per invocation; after 3 agent calls on synthetic records, agentCallCount === 3; WHY: covers basic counting at the executor call site
reviewArtifact call increments agentCallCount by 1; after 2 agent + 1 review calls, agentCallCount === 3; WHY: covers the reviewer call site that was previously undercounted via reviewRounds

tokensSpent accumulated from claude JSON usage.input_tokens + usage.output_tokens across all calls; 3 calls with usage {in:100,out:50} each => tokensSpent === 450; WHY: covers token extraction and accumulation
wallClockMs is present in output record and is a positive number; WHY: confirms existing field preserved per pre-reg
output record contains exact pre-reg section 7 field names: tokensSpent, wallClockMs, agentCallCount; WHY: field-name compliance with locked pre-registration

edge.desc: zero-token response (usage.input_tokens=0, usage.output_tokens=0) => tokensSpent accumulates 0, not NaN or undefined; WHY: edge where model returns empty usage
missing usage field in claude JSON output => tokensSpent defaults to 0 for that call, not NaN/throw; WHY: defensive against malformed claude output
single attempt R=1 succeeds => agentCallCount=1 not 0 or 2; WHY: boundary on minimum call count

adversarial.desc: claude JSON contains negative token counts => tokensSpent accumulates correctly or implementation-defined; WHY: adversarial malformed data from model API
infra void on first call => agentCallCount reflects only calls actually made not max R; WHY: ensures count is actual not planned

verificationEvidence.note: selfcheck "CHK-001 h2": tokensFromUsage({in:100,out:50})=150 and 3x accumulated=450 (input_tokens+output_tokens summed).
selfcheck "CHK-001 h0": replayBudgetLoop (shared increment-then-check primitive the real loop uses) counts 3 executor calls => agentCallCount 3.

selfcheck "CHK-001 h1": every call (executor AND reviewer) increments; 2+1 calls => agentCallCount 3. reviewArtifact() increment is at run-recovery.mjs agentCallCount++ before the reviewer execFileSync.
selfcheck "CHK-001 h3": buildRunRecord (the shared builder the real record literal spreads) carries wallClockMs as a positive number.
selfcheck "CHK-001 h4": buildRunRecord output has the exact pre-reg section 7 names tokensSpent/wallClockMs/agentCallCount; the real record spreads buildRunRecord(...) at run-recovery.mjs.
selfcheck "CHK-001 e0": zero usage {in:0,out:0} => tokensFromUsage 0, not NaN/undefined.
selfcheck "CHK-001 e1": JSON with no usage field => tokensFromUsage 0 (defensive default), not NaN/throw.
selfcheck "CHK-001 e2": single call (R=1 style) => agentCallCount 1, not 0 or 2.

items.title: run-recovery.mjs: add a spend-budget mode (token + wall-clock budget args) that truncates the loop when cumulative tokens >= tokenBudget OR wall-clock >= wallBudget (token binds first); record budget pass/fail and a truncated flag
items.context: Hard-truncation cap at the upper bound; used by A2-prime

happy.desc: when cumulative tokensSpent >= tokenBudget, loop terminates and record.truncated === true; WHY: covers the primary token-binds-first truncation rule
when cumulative wallClockMs >= wallBudget and tokens still under budget, loop terminates with truncated=true; WHY: covers wall-clock binding when token is not the constraint
when both budgets are NOT exceeded across all R iterations, truncated === false and budgetPass === true; WHY: covers the non-truncation normal completion path
record contains budgetPass field (boolean) reflecting whether the run stayed within budget; WHY: pre-reg requires per-run budget pass/fail logging

edge.desc: tokenBudget exactly equals cumulative tokens after final call => truncated should be true (>= not >); WHY: boundary at exact budget match
budget mode with R=1 and first call exceeds token budget => single call runs but truncated=true on that call; WHY: minimum-iteration boundary
zero tokenBudget => first call immediately triggers truncation; WHY: degenerate budget boundary
no budget args provided => budget mode is OFF, no truncation, budgetPass/truncated fields absent or null; WHY: backward compatibility with non-budget runs

adversarial.desc: token budget is very small (1 token) but wall budget is very large => token binds first, loop stops after first call regardless of wall budget; WHY: verifies token-binds-first precedence under extreme asymmetry
negative tokenBudget value => implementation should reject or treat as immediate truncation, not loop forever; WHY: adversarial invalid input
wall clock jumps due to system clock skew mid-run => wallClockMs still computed correctly via monotonic timing or Date.now delta; WHY: adversarial timing scenario

verificationEvidence.note: selfcheck "CHK-002 h0": cumulative tokens reaching tokenBudget => truncated true (replayBudgetLoop uses the same budgetExceeded + break the real loop calls at run-recovery.mjs).
selfcheck "CHK-002 h1": wall-clock reaching wallBudget while tokens under => truncated true.
selfcheck "CHK-002 h2": under both budgets across iterations => truncated false, and budgetPass true when actual within band.

budgetPass is computed and written into the run record by run-ablation.mjs line 138 (enriched.budgetPass = budgetPass(run.tokensSpent, medTokens)) then appended at line 140; the boolean correctness of budgetPass() is unit-tested by selfcheck "CHK-002 h3" / "CHK-003 h3". Field-presence-in-the-jsonl is code-review (logic) since writing the file requires a live ablation run.
selfcheck "CHK-002 e0": tokens exactly equal to budget => truncated true (>= boundary, not >).
selfcheck "CHK-002 e1": R=1-style single call over budget => agentCallCount 1 with truncated true on that call.
selfcheck "CHK-002 e2": zero tokenBudget => first call immediately truncates (tokens 0 >= budget 0).

selfcheck "CHK-002 e3": no budget args => budget mode OFF (both null) => truncated false even at huge spend; buildRunRecord defaults truncated=false. Real loop guards every cap check with budgetMode at run-recovery.mjs.
selfcheck "CHK-002 a0": tokenBudget=1, wallBudgetMs=1e12 => token binds FIRST, loop stops after the first call regardless of the huge wall budget.
selfcheck "CHK-002 a1": negative tokenBudget => any tokens>=negative immediately truncates; no infinite loop.

selfcheck "CHK-002 a2": elapsed is an accumulated per-call delta; the real loop uses Date.now()-t0 (a monotonic-style delta from a single t0), so wall-clock is skew-immune relative to absolute clock jumps. budgetExceeded operates on the delta.

items.title: run-ablation.mjs: compute A4 (a4b) per-task median tokensSpent + wallClockMs; add the A2-prime arm = a2prime under that budget (plus-or-minus 20 percent, token binds first, hard-truncate at upper bound); record to ablation-A2prime-compute-matched.jsonl with per-run budget pass/fail
items.context: A2-prime is a2prime bounded by A4 median spend, not call count

happy.desc: median computation on odd-length A4 tokensSpent array [100,300,200] => median=200; WHY: covers basic median calculation for budget derivation
median computation on even-length A4 tokensSpent array [100,200,300,400] => median=250; WHY: covers even-count averaging
A2-prime arm budget = A4 median +/- 20 pct; for median=1000 tokens, tokenBudget=1200 (upper bound), wallBudget=median_wall*1.2; WHY: covers the tolerance band derivation
A2-prime records written to ablation-A2prime-compute-matched.jsonl with budgetPass field; WHY: covers output file naming and per-run budget logging per pre-reg
A2-prime arm invokes run-recovery.mjs with arm=a2prime and budget args derived from A4 median; WHY: covers correct wiring of budget into the runner

edge.desc: single A4 record => median = that single value; WHY: minimum sample size boundary
all A4 records identical tokensSpent => median = that value, budget = value*1.2; WHY: zero-variance edge
A4 median wallClockMs is 0 (all instant) => wallBudget=0, still valid; WHY: degenerate zero-time edge
per-TASK median: each task gets its own budget from that task A4 runs, not a global median; WHY: verifies per-task granularity

adversarial.desc: no A4 records exist for a task (empty array) => median computation should error or skip, not produce NaN budget; WHY: missing prerequisite data
A4 records contain null tokensSpent values => median computation excludes nulls or errors, not silently corrupt budget; WHY: dirty prerequisite JSONL
A4 JSONL file is truncated mid-line (incomplete JSON) => parser handles gracefully, does not crash; WHY: adversarial file corruption

verificationEvidence.note: selfcheck "CHK-003 h0": median([100,300,200])=200 (odd-length).
selfcheck "CHK-003 h1": median([100,200,300,400])=250 (even-length average).
selfcheck "CHK-003 h2": a2primeBudget(1000,2000)={tokenBudget:1200,wallBudgetMs:2400} = round(1.2*median) upper bound of the +/-20pct band.

run-ablation.mjs lines 149-155 build the enriched record with tokenInBand, wallInBand, and budgetPass = budgetPass(run.tokensSpent, run.wallClockMs, medTokens, medWall) and append it to ablation-A2prime-compute-matched.jsonl (A2P_FILE). budgetPass now requires BOTH the token AND wall-clock axes within +/-20pct of A4's per-task median (pre-reg section 47); it is unit-tested across both axes (selfcheck CHK-003 h3/h5/a3/a4/a5/a6/a7). File-write at runtime needs a live ablation run, so the integration is code-review (logic).

run-ablation.mjs lines 138-140 invoke run-recovery.mjs with --arm a2prime and --tokenBudget/--wallBudgetMs taken from a2primeBudget(median(...)) (line 124, derived from per-task A4 medTokens/medWall). The median->budget derivation chain is unit-tested (selfcheck CHK-003 h4); the per-task A4 median wall-clock (medWall) is also what feeds budgetPass's wall-clock band check at line 154. The actual subprocess spawn needs the live LLM, so the wiring is code-review (logic).
selfcheck "CHK-003 e0": median([777])=777 (single record).
selfcheck "CHK-003 e1": identical values [500,500,500] => median 500, a2primeBudget tokenBudget=600 (value*1.2).
selfcheck "CHK-003 e2": median wall 0 => a2primeBudget wallBudgetMs 0 (still valid, no NaN).

selfcheck "CHK-003 e3": distinct task arrays yield distinct medians (100 vs 900); run-ablation.mjs line 105 filters a4Records by r.taskId===task so each task gets its OWN budget (per-task granularity), not a global median.
selfcheck "CHK-003 a0": empty array => median null; a2primeBudget(null,null)={null,null}; run-ablation.mjs lines 109-112 skip the task (no NaN budget) when both are null.
selfcheck "CHK-003 a1": median([null,100,null,300])=200; nulls are filtered BEFORE Number() coercion (run-ablation.mjs median) so they do not become spurious zeros.

run-ablation.mjs line 102 wraps JSON.parse in try/catch returning null for a truncated/incomplete final line, then filters Boolean (line 103) so a corrupt line is dropped, not crashing. Additionally selfcheck "CHK-003 a2" shows median ignores the resulting non-finite/undefined values. Graceful-parse is code-review (logic) since it lives in runMain file I/O.

items.title: Document the spend-match semantics (token+wall-clock, not call count; plus-or-minus 20 percent; token binds first; hard-truncate) in the run-recovery.mjs / run-ablation.mjs comments, citing the pre-reg
items.context: So the paper claim is precise and matches lattice-experiment-protocol.md

happy.desc: Code comments in run-recovery.mjs and run-ablation.mjs document spend-match semantics (token+wall-clock, not call count; +/-20 pct; token binds first; hard-truncate) and cite the pre-reg; WHY: docs-check item, verified by code review not unit test

edge.desc: the comment names the EXACT pre-reg source (lattice-experiment-protocol.md, the A2-prime row in section 1) and the precise tolerance (plus-or-minus 20 pct of A4 per-task median, token binds first, hard-truncate at upper bound); WHY: a vague comment is not auditable against the locked pre-registration

the comment appears in BOTH run-recovery.mjs (near the budget-truncation logic) AND run-ablation.mjs (near the A2-prime arm setup); WHY: both files implement spend-match behavior and both must be independently traceable to the pre-reg

adversarial.desc: the comment does NOT mislabel the match as call-count or claim per-run spend-parity; it must state budget/spend-match (token+wall-clock) precisely; WHY: the whole point of this story is to not reintroduce the compute-confound wording the paper previously got wrong

the comment does NOT cite a stale pre-reg revision or wrong section number; it must reference the current rev3.1 and section 1 A2-prime row; WHY: adversarial against copy-paste from an older draft that used call-count semantics

verificationEvidence.note: run-recovery.mjs header comment (the spend budget + accounting helpers block) and run-ablation.mjs header comment (the A2-prime compute-matched arm block) both document: spend-match on token+wall-clock NOT call count, +/-20pct band, token binds first, hard-truncate at upper bound.

Both files name the EXACT source: "lattice-experiment-protocol.md rev3.1 §1 (the A2-prime row)" and cite +/-20pct of A4 per-task median, token binds first, hard-truncate at the upper bound (run-recovery.mjs budgetExceeded comment + truncated-flag comment; run-ablation.mjs header + a2primeBudget comment).

The semantics appear in BOTH files: run-recovery.mjs near budgetExceeded() and the in-loop truncation checks (the "Spend-budget hard-truncation cap (A2-prime)" comments), and run-ablation.mjs near the A2-prime arm setup (header + the "A2-prime compute-matched arm" section comment). Each is independently traceable to the pre-reg.

Comments explicitly say "matched on SPEND (total tokens + wall-clock), NOT on call count" (run-recovery.mjs) and "spend-matched ... NOT by call count" (run-ablation.mjs); they describe a budget/cap, never per-run spend-parity, so the prior compute-confound wording is not reintroduced.

Comments cite the CURRENT revision "rev3.1" and "§1 (the A2-prime row)" + "§7" in both files; no stale revision or wrong section number. Verified against the authority doc header (Status rev3.1) and §1 A2-prime row / §7 schema.
